title: A room for the work nobody sees
subtitle: Kona.m × Lionel Sanders × Zwift — concept only, not an announced partnership
core_idea: The pitch should feel like entering the room, not watching a sales presentation.

public.title: Why I made Kona.m
copy: It started with getting pulled back toward triathlon.
Then I wanted to understand the bike. That became data. The data became 3D. The bike needed a room. The room somehow became a world.
Kona.m is where I put things I care about in the same place: triathlon, learning, AI, design, systems, stories and the joy of making something I did not know how to make.
A big part of it is simply learning to finish enough of an idea to let other people in.
public.visual_arc: training → spreadsheet/data → AI → bike → room → museum → island/world

lionel.title: The version I wanted you to see
copy: One reason I wanted to make this room for you is that your public story has never looked perfectly polished.
You have shown the experiments, the bad calls, the missed races, the overthinking, the rebuilding and the moments when reality forced a change.
That matters to me more than a clean highlight reel.
I have spent the last few years trying to turn curiosity, difficult periods, creativity and a lot of learning into something constructive. Kona.m became one of the ways I could do that.
So this is not really a monument to winning. It is a room about doing the work, being willing to look at what did not work, changing, and coming back.
lionel.guardrail: Frame this as the creator's response to Lionel's documented public openness. Do not diagnose, speculate about motives, or claim private similarity.

storyboard.title: Black
storyboard.visual: Almost-black screen. Small KONA.m mark. Room ambience before image.

storyboard.title: Threshold
storyboard.visual: Slow dolly through the basalt entrance. Trainer screen visible far inside.

storyboard.title: The machine
storyboard.visual: Orbit around bike + smart trainer + giant training screen. Fans wake subtly. Data appears.
storyboard.copy: A room for the work nobody sees.

storyboard.title: Zwift
storyboard.visual: Camera crosses the screen, desk, bottles and heat zone. UI labels appear as understated KONA.m annotations.
storyboard.copy: Zwift is the companion. Kona is the destination.

storyboard.title: Iterations
storyboard.visual: Four race-story artworks: sketch, editorial, blueprint, manga. Never copied race photographs.
Abstract sculpture 'The Gap'. A narrow orange line between two stone forms. 8:04:07 appears quietly.
storyboard.copy: Second in Kona. Not the ending.

storyboard.title: The weird bits
storyboard.visual: Treadmill, recovery mat, tiny overthinking joke board, medal drawer, hidden collectible, dog easter-egg slot reserved but off by default.
storyboard.copy: Serious work. Not always a serious room.

storyboard.title: About
storyboard.visual: World pulls back. Brief creator origin sequence: training → data → 3D bike → room → world.
storyboard.copy: I did not start by trying to build a company. I started by trying to understand something.

storyboard.title: The version for Lionel
storyboard.visual: Return to the cave after the lights soften. Show imperfect notes, crossed-out training ideas and the Silver Lining sculpture.
storyboard.copy: What stayed with me was not only the results. It was the willingness to show the messy part between them.

storyboard.title: Open ending
storyboard.visual: Camera faces the Kona horizon from behind the trainer. No athlete avatar. Empty bike waiting.
storyboard.copy: This is only the first room. What would you put in it?

capture_requirements: Use screenshots/renders from the actual branch implementation, not generated fake UI, for final pitch.
Use generated concept art only as transition material and clearly separate it from actual product footage.
Final room footage must show free camera movement through a genuinely explorable 3D space.
Keep KONA.m shell typography and minimal chrome.
Do not imply Zwift, Lionel Sanders, Canyon or IRONMAN approval or sponsorship.
Include an optional final invitation card offering an in-person Kona walkthrough and collaborative 3D/content capture, without implying agreement or attendance.

evidence_notes.note: Sanders said he was starting to welcome adversity because it let him practice staying composed when races did not go to plan.
Sanders described acknowledging reality as a theme and discussed becoming smarter about recovery.
Sanders said he did not regret everything in his past because it shaped him, and framed his goal as proof that people can change.
Second place, 8:04:07 after leading much of the marathon.

in_person_invitation.title: If this is more interesting in person
copy: I am happy to fly to Kona and show this properly face-to-face.
We could walk through the room together, change what is wrong, add what is missing, and decide whether any of it deserves to become something bigger.
And if it is fun, we can make something from Kona while we are there: a small 3D capture, an object, a room detail, a deliberately strange piece of content, or the beginning of the next space.
in_person_invitation.posture: An open invitation, not an assumption of access, partnership, travel reimbursement or participation.
